name: agenticqa-vscode
description: Agentic AI orchestrator for QA automation engineers with token-usage telemetry for GitHub Copilot Chat.

chatParticipants.name: agenticQA
chatParticipants.description: AgenticQA orchestrator for QA automation tasks (with token-usage tracking).

agenticqa.serverPort.description: Local port (127.0.0.1 only) for the AgenticQA collector and dashboard.

agenticqa.manageOtelSettings.description: Automatically enable Copilot Chat OpenTelemetry token export to the local capture file.

agenticqa.showTokenMeterInChat.description: Append a token meter note to @agenticQA chat responses.

agenticqa.orchestrator.jarPath.description: Absolute path to agenticqa-orchestrator.jar (the Java RAG orchestrator). Leave empty to use the jar bundled with the extension (orchestrator/agenticqa-orchestrator.jar).
